HEADING is run on every ATX heading line of a declared document. The lazy `(.*?)` followed by `[ \t]*$` is quadratic when the heading line holds a long run of spaces or tabs in the middle followed by a non-space character: at each lazy expansion position inside the run, `[ \t]*` consumes the rest of the run, `$` fails, and it backtracks one step at a time. `stripClosingHashes` (`/[ \t]+#+$/`) has the same shape on the matched text. Nothing caps the line length: the resolver accepts a file up to CONTRACT_MAX_BYTES (262144), `inspectDocument` in references-check.ts the same, and the validator's `currentSection` in reference-proof.ts reads the file with no size limit.
